hero.bio: Software engineer in Toronto building *full-stack apps and HTTP APIs* with *TypeScript, Node.js and C#/.NET* on SQL Server. At BarAI, I built and ran Mergify, a Shopify app rated 4.6/5. Off the clock, I write music with *FL Studio* and a *piano*.

projects.title: Projects.
projects.intro: From production SaaS to coursework. Each one taught me something I still use.

items.title: Mergify
items.desc: A Shopify-integrated app that merges orders automatically so merchants save on shipping. I built production features end to end, moved its Shopify integration from REST to GraphQL for 30% faster fetches, and shipped the undo-merge feature merchants asked for most.
items.linkLabel: view on the Shopify App Store

items.title: ZibaEats + Todo CRUD
items.desc: Two .NET applications: a CRUD Todo app and the backend of ZibaEats, an e-commerce concept. HTTP endpoints with ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs, data in SQL Server through Entity Framework, organised as vertical slices with CQRS and unit tests alongside each feature.

items.title: MyTones
items.desc: A production-grade HTTP/REST API with 25+ endpoints written without a framework: JWT authentication, role-based authorization, a PostgreSQL schema through Prisma, and Redis caching. Three services run in Docker Compose behind Nginx, deployed by GitHub Actions and documented in Swagger.

items.title: FXLedger
items.desc: FX quotes, payments and a double-entry ledger where every transfer writes balanced entries, so the books can be checked at any point in time.

items.title: MarketMate
items.sub: AI chatbot · NSBE Hacks 3rd place · Feb 2025
items.desc: I led a team of four to build an AI chatbot that helps people price and negotiate marketplace listings. I owned the requirements, the backend API integration and the coordination, and we placed 3rd.

items.title: 3D Rendering Engine
items.desc: A 3D rendering pipeline that draws 1,000+ polygons at 60 FPS, with vertex processing, rasterization, fragment shading, matrix transformations and Phong lighting.

items.title: OS Simulation
items.desc: An operating system simulation that compares 4 CPU scheduling algorithms across 100+ simulated processes, measuring efficiency and resource-allocation trade-offs.

items.title: Java Projects
items.sub: Spring Boot Todo · Othello · coursework & personal
items.desc: A Todo CRUD app in Java and Spring Boot, plus an Othello game and a command-line library-management system built with classes, abstraction and inheritance.

items.title: Django & Flask APIs
items.desc: Todo CRUD REST API backends built twice, once in Django and once in Flask, with create, read, update and delete endpoints in Python.

items.title: AllinServer
items.desc: My own Ubuntu server on Oracle Cloud in Toronto. Hardened, Dockerised, and fronted by Nginx. This site is served from it.

items.title: Abanico Dance
items.desc: Maintaining and improving the website for a Toronto-area dance studio, from fixes and performance to new pages for its upcoming café.
Mergify, a Shopify-integrated SaaS app for automated order merging.
bullets: Built and maintained production parts of Mergify: HTTP/REST APIs in Node.js (Express.js) and React front-end work, backed by Mocha/Chai unit tests and code reviews.
Cut Shopify fetch time by 30% by moving 16+ functions from its REST API to GraphQL, including currency conversion for order data.
Implemented BullMQ job queues handling 100+ concurrent jobs, with worker orchestration that prevents race conditions in order processing.
Built the fault-tolerant undo-merge feature, walking order trees backwards to restore original states, which helped the app reach 4.6/5 on the Shopify App Store.
Worked across SQL Server and MongoDB (Mongoose), and migrated services to AWS on EC2, S3 and Elastic Load Balancing.
Handled on-call production support and incident analysis, completed 130+ user stories at a 90%+ rate in biweekly sprints, and wrote 1,900+ lines of API, schema and architecture docs.

items.desc: I keep the studio's site fast, accurate and easy to update, and I'm building out its online presence as the studio opens a café. I also perform with the studio's company on stage!
